PraisonAIUI includes a modular, extendable Notification Center built into @aiui/sdk and shipped as a first-party plugin (builtin.notifications).

See live notifications, header bell alerts, deep-link actions, and Human-in-the-Loop approvals working together on one dashboard in 34-hitl-approvals-and-notifications (aiui run app.py or aiui run app.yaml — no API key required). Declare startup or static notifications directly in app.yaml:

Headless SDK store (@aiui/sdk: notifications, useNotifications) Holds the single client-side notification list, unread count, deduplication (dedupeKey / id), ring-buffer cap, and optimistic actions (markRead, markUnread, markAllRead, remove, clear, sync). Automatically records calls to notify(message, opts) unless opts.record === false, so ephemeral toasts stay reviewable in the bell panel without duplicating code at call sites. Extendable via notifications.registerSource(id, source) for custom transports (WebSockets, SSE, polling, webhooks). Header Bell plugin (builtin.notifications) Registers a lightweight bell trigger into the header:actions slot, so it appears in the Classic shell and selectable layout frames. Lazily loads its popover panel on hover, focus, or click to keep boot bundles small. Supports All / Unread / dynamic category filters, Mark all read, per-item read toggle & dismiss, safe SPA action links (action.page + params), keyboard Escape, and polite screen-reader announcements. Disable it with extensions: { disabled: ["builtin.notifications"] } or replace it by registering your own header:actions slot component backed by useNotifications(). Python Feature & SDK (praisonaiui.features.notifications) Mounts authenticated REST and SSE endpoints (/api/notifications, /api/notifications/read-all, /api/notifications/{id}/read, /api/notifications/{id}, /api/notifications/stream). Pluggable storage via NotificationStoreProtocol and aiui.set_notification_store(store).
